statement.text: "With House leadership refusing to bring any proposal to the floor, I am signing another discharge petition to force a vote and prevent higher health care costs for families in the Hudson Valley." Lawler's office said this was the third discharge petition he had signed on extending the enhanced ACA credits.

sources.title: Office of Rep. Lawler

action.text: Voted Yea on H.R. 1834, a three-year extension of the enhanced ACA premium tax credits brought to the floor by discharge petition (roll call 11, Jan. 8, 2026); it passed 230-196, with 17 Republicans voting yes.
